system.description:
Beginning at 17th level, your body is constantly producing massive quantities of nature release chakra.

At the beginning of your turn while you are in Elemental Flux, you may spend one superiority die to gain immunity to the damage type of your current Elemental Flux type until the beginning of your next turn.

Additionally, while you are in Elemental Flux you can use one additional maneuver on your turn.

| #### Design Note(s) / Elemental Scout / On a first read, Elemental Scout can seem a bit complex. But I ask to read the first two features a second time. And then again if needed. / The core mechanic is very simple in reality. The complexity comes into play exclusively when the Player themselves wishes to inject more nature releases into their loadout. / This E-Scout does not care about what nature release you picked, instead it only cares about what nature releases you use. / So, if you have only the class, you will at most have 2 Flux Types, which isn't a lot to keep track of. / It’s when you want to try and collect all 5 like Pokémon, does it begin to feel/become overwhelming. |
